headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING

periods.name: Rest of today
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots. A slight chance of showers late this morning, then showers this afternoon. A chance of waterspouts this afternoon. Waves 2 to 4 feet building to 4 to 7 feet. Waves occasionally around 9 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots. Rain showers likely in the evening, then a slight chance of rain showers overnight. Waves 4 to 7 feet subsiding to 3 to 6 feet. Waves occasionally around 9 feet.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 10 to 15 knots. A chance of rain showers. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Friday night
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots becoming northwest 10 to 15 knots. A chance of rain showers in the evening. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Saturday through Monday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 54 degrees, off Cleveland 58 degrees, and off Erie 55 degrees.
